# Data card: UpayShield synthetic mobile-money dataset

**Source: 100% SYNTHETIC** (generated by `scripts/generate_data.py`, seed 42, 800 users, 40 agents, 30 days, Bangladesh-flavoured). No real customer data. Accuracy measured on it is optimistic.

## Model inputs

`ml/features.py` defines **32** model features:

`amount`, `log_amount`, `type_code`, `hour`, `is_night`, `amount_z`, `hour_freq`, `amount_to_balance`, `log_secs_since_last`, `is_new_device`, `is_new_location`, `is_new_recipient`, `txn_count_1h`, `amount_sum_1h`, `recipient_unique_senders`, `recipient_inbound_count`, `recipient_age_txns`, `device_users_count`, `inbound_1h`, `passthrough_ratio`, `near_thr_24h`, `agent_txn_1h`, `agent_cashout_ratio`, `is_gambling`, `gambling_txn_24h`, `log_gambling_spend_7d`, `is_new_category`, `otp_requests_10m`, `otp_failures_10m`, `otp_device_mismatch`, `concurrent_sessions`, `sim_swap_recent`
